install.notes: pyproject.toml:9 requires Python 3.10 or newer and :18 pins mujoco>=3.3.3; the rest of the dependencies (dm-control, dm-env, gdm-robotics) are for the upstream environments, not for loading the model. Neither the gate nor the fake backend needs any of them: fake.py is pure Python and reads the MJCF text, and the gate never installs or imports the upstream package.
